title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull In Solid Brass | Cabinet Hardware Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Refresh bathroom cabinetry with a small upgrade that makes drawers and cabinet doors easier to use and look more finished. This 3 inch cabinet pull coordinates with the Cabinet Hardware collection for a cohesive, transitional feel.

  • Upgrade daily touchpoints: decorative pull provides a comfortable, reliable grip for opening drawers and doors.
  • Coordinate across the room: designed to pair with other pieces in the Cabinet Hardware collection—ideal for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass construction.
  • Simpler install: mounting hardware is included.
  • Finish flexibility: available in a wide variety of designer finishes.

Specs & Details
Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 x 1.6 x 3 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 3 x 3 x 3 in.
Shipping weight: 1 lb.
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
Assembled in the USA
